    First extension groups as derivations modulo inner derivations #

    For a k-algebra A and A-modules M, X, we model Ext¹_A(M, X) as the k-linear derivations δ : A → Hom_k(M, X), meaning δ(ab)(m) = a • δ(b)(m) + δ(a)(b • m), modulo the inner derivations a ↦ (m ↦ a • φ(m) - φ(a • m)). A derivation δ describes the extension X ⊕ M with action a • (x, m) = (a • x + δ(a)(m), a • m).

    • Ext1.finrank_hom_le: for a surjection q : M → N with kernel L, the dimension of Hom(M', N) is at most that of the image of Hom(M', M) plus that of Ext¹(M', L). This is the part of the long exact sequence used in Step 2 of Proposition 2.1.
    • Ext1.finrank_congr: isomorphic second arguments give the same dimension.

                Module.finrank k (M' →ₗ[A] N) ≤ Module.finrank k ↥(postcomp k A M q).range + Module.finrank k ↥(Ext1 k A M' ↥q.ker)

                Long exact sequence, the part used in Proposition 2.1. For a surjection q : M → N and any module M', a homomorphism M' → N whose connecting class in Ext¹(M', ker q) vanishes lifts through q; consequently dim Hom(M', N) ≤ dim (q ∘ Hom(M', M)) + dim Ext¹(M', ker q).
